source_observations.scope: Different 2020 research specimens, not new H29 specimens
Range discussed in paper; Table 1 also has higher-density counterexamples. Lab-produced dried powder, not aged ski bed
2016 brochure typical molded-specimen HDT, not universal 50C operating limit

assumptions_and_limits: 120 kg/m3 is a comparison target, not a demonstrated finished density or snow-feel optimum.
500 JPY/kg and all transport/annual budget values are hypothetical, ex-tax; not supplier quotes.
Damage fraction is an unknown morphological conversion fraction, not dust emission or measured attrition.
Mixture model adds separately measured apparent bulk volumes; nonconvex particles may interpenetrate. It is a reference, not a proven upper/lower bound.
Renewal assumes rejected morphology cannot be restored onsite, replacement material equal in mass; no disposal/salvage/energy cost included.
Vehicle numbers are volume/mass bookkeeping only; no road, bag compression, packing efficiency or commercial availability validation.
Annual contamination fractions are hypothetical non-overlapping replacements, not measured mold growth or antimicrobial performance.
